description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot configuration class for setting up Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) globally across the application. It configures allowed origins, HTTP methods, headers, and cache duration for preflight requests, primarily enhancing cross-origin communications for Swagger UI and other web clients.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines a bean for global CORS filter setup, including allowed origins, methods, headers, and cache duration.

methods.name: corsFilter
methods.description: Creates and returns a CorsFilter bean with comprehensive CORS settings, including specific allowed origins, methods, headers, exposed headers, and preflight cache duration.
